fieldValues.title: The owner may request a further agent review
fieldValues.decision_question: How does the owner ask an agent to review a PR again, or from another stance?
fieldValues.context: Proposed by agent:claude-code from the srs-lab control room (clerk#77). Prototyped against the live PRs on 2026-10-17: clerk#57 asked for thirteen decisions already ratified; srs-programme#154 and #155 proposed decisions only inside their diffs, in state draft; clerk#75 stated a constraining design principle in prose.
fieldValues.decision_statement: The owner requests a further review with the review:requested label and an srs:review-request comment naming seat, stance and focus; the group reviewer reviews once more and removes the label.
fieldValues.rationale: The reviewer exits once a quorum newer than the head exists, so today a second look needs a new commit or a human review.
